===================== COMBINED: search and scoring are the =====================
=====================   SAME condition, not two populations ====================

The climb is guided by the SAME score the bonus would adjust, so a true
key that does not stand out is also one whose plugboard the climb cannot
find.  Scoring failure therefore presents as a SEARCH failure first:

   oracle outcome                 trials   climb OK   rate
   truth wins big (< -100 dec)    48       22         46%
   truth wins (-100..0)           34       12         35%
   truth loses (0..+50)           23       1          4%
   truth loses big (> +50)        35       0          0%

   -> 0 of 35 trials where the truth would lose big ever recovered, so the
      bonus never sees a decrypt to read a doubling out of.  Across both
      runs: 35 recovered trials, true key already top in 35.
